children: Civeo reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $193.1M and net income of $5.18M, compared with $170.49M in revenue and a $455K net loss in the prior-year quarter. Diluted EPS was $0.5, versus a loss of $0.04 per share.

¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to Civeo Corporation”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income (loss) per share attributable to Civeo Corporation common shareholders”.
Third-quarter revenue rose 13% year over year, driven by Canadian lodge occupancy, new Canadian services work and currency effects.
Canadian billed lodge rooms increased 35%; a new Ontario integrated-services contract began in the second quarter of 2026.
Australian revenue grew 4% with currency support, while lower Bowen Basin occupancy and labor shortages pressured margins.
Nine-month revenue increased 14%, supported by new integrated-services business, the Qantac acquisition and higher Canadian occupancy.
LNG Canada Phase 2 received final investment approval; construction and the Coastal GasLink expansion are expected to support regional lodging demand.
